observations: Photo 0 shows a Bosch ECU with a black plastic cover and a label with 'BOSCH' and '07K 907 309 600 907 500 C' printed on it.
Photo 1 shows the same ECU from a different angle, with a clear label reading '07K 906 055 CR', 'BOSCH', 'Assembled in Mexico', and 'MOTRONIC'.
Photo 2 shows the top of the ECU with a label that reads '07K 906 055 CR', 'BOSCH', and 'Assembled in Mexico'.
The ECU has a black plastic housing with visible wear and dirt, and a bundle of colorful wires extending from the side.
The label in photo 1 and photo 2 includes '07K 906 055 CR' and 'BENZIN ME17.5.6', which is a BMW model code, not a Volkswagen code.
The seller claims to deal in Volkswagen, Audi, Porsche, and Bentley parts, but the ECU is clearly labeled as a BMW part (07K 906 055 CR).
The watermark 'EZE PORSCHE GLOBAL AUTOS' is present on all photos, suggesting the seller may be misrepresenting the part as a Porsche part.
